visibility.playbookSubtitle: Operational checklist — pair with your visibility data and optional done-for-you GEO services.
visibility.playbookDisclaimer: This is guidance, not legal advice. AI answers vary by platform, region, and day.
visibility.playbookS1Body:
Set vertical to E‑commerce, language, and market (US vs IT affects location signals in API runs).
Add store platform + catalog notes so AI-generated questions match your SKUs.
Define one tracked brand and 2–5 competitor stores you lose deals to.
visibility.playbookS2Body:
Ship clean product JSON-LD (Product, Offer, AggregateRating where true).
Publish clear shipping, returns, and contact pages — models often cite these for trust.
Keep robots.txt and sitemap friendly to major AI crawlers you care about.
visibility.playbookS3Body:
Start with the starter pack + one AI batch; dedupe near-identical prompts.
Prioritize category + “where to buy” + “is [brand] legit” intents before long-tail SKUs.
Run ChatGPT + Google AI Overview first; add engines as you scale.
visibility.playbookS4Body:
If Amazon or big retailers dominate citations, invest in editorial and UGC you control.
If competitors’ blogs appear, map content gaps and publish buyer guides that answer the same questions.
Export CSV monthly for reporting — agencies love a paper trail.
Use Improve → Deep analytics for share of voice, week-over-week trends, and full CSV exports.

helpPage.q1Question: How do I create my first project?
helpPage.q1Answer: After signing up, click "Create New Project" on the dashboard. Enter your website URL and we'll automatically analyze your niche and suggest keywords. You can then generate a topical map and start creating content.
helpPage.q2Question: What are credits and how do they work?
helpPage.q2Answer: Credits are used for AI operations like content generation, keyword research, and rank tracking. Each plan includes a monthly credit allocation that resets at the start of each billing cycle. You can see your remaining credits in the sidebar.
helpPage.q3Question: How long does it take to generate content?
helpPage.q3Answer: Content generation typically takes 30-60 seconds depending on the article length and complexity. Our AI researches the topic, analyzes competitor content, and creates SEO-optimized articles with proper structure and formatting.
helpPage.q4Question: Can I edit the AI-generated content?
helpPage.q4Answer: Yes! All generated content is fully editable. We recommend reviewing and customizing the content to match your brand voice before publishing. The built-in editor supports rich formatting, images, and internal linking suggestions.
helpPage.q5Question: What makes the generated content SEO-optimized?
helpPage.q5Answer: Our AI analyzes SERP results for your target keyword, identifies content gaps, includes relevant secondary keywords, optimizes heading structure, and ensures proper keyword density. Each article includes an SEO score and specific recommendations.
helpPage.q6Question: Does the content pass AI detection?
helpPage.q6Answer: Our content is designed to be high-quality and natural. While we don't guarantee passing all AI detectors, we use advanced techniques to create human-like content. We recommend adding personal insights and examples to make content uniquely yours.
helpPage.q7Answer: We track your keyword positions on Google daily. You'll see position changes, visibility trends, and SERP features. Set up tracking by adding keywords to your project - we'll automatically monitor rankings and alert you to significant changes.
helpPage.q8Answer: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Tracking monitors how often your brand is mentioned by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. This helps you understand your visibility in the emerging AI search landscape.
helpPage.q9Question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
helpPage.q9Answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time from Settings > Billing. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated charges. Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle.
helpPage.q10Answer: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new subscriptions. If you're not satisfied, contact us within 14 days of your first payment for a full refund.
helpPage.q11Answer: Currently, credits do not roll over to the next month. We recommend using your allocation before the billing cycle ends. We're considering rollover as a future feature for higher-tier plans.
helpPage.q12Answer: Yes! You can export content as Markdown, HTML, or copy it directly to your clipboard. We're also working on WordPress and CMS integrations for direct publishing.
helpPage.q13Answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption, secure authentication via Supabase, and never share your content or data with third parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.
